visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a light blue tube top stands against a plain white curtain background, holding a silver iPad and addressing the camera with an expressive facial expression. She wears gold-colored bow earrings and a beaded bracelet on her wrist while gesturing towards the tablet screen. (2) A close-up view focuses on the iPad screen displaying a pink mahjong-themed cartoon wallpaper featuring two lions. The host's hand, with neatly manicured yellow and white nails, rotates the device from portrait to landscape mode to demonstrate the wallpaper's alignment issue against the grey tabletop. (3) A digital interface screen recording of the Meitu Xiuxiu app is shown. The user navigates through a gallery of photos, selecting two cartoon images—one of white characters and another of mahjong tiles—then uses the collage and stitch tools to combine them vertically on the screen. (4) The camera captures the host's hands manipulating the iPad's wallpaper settings. She toggles between horizontal and vertical orientations, using her fingers to pinch and drag the composite image so that the specific cartoon elements align correctly within the frame for both viewing modes on the bright display. (5) The video returns to a medium shot of the host holding the iPad. She smiles broadly while tilting the device back and forth, showing that the wallpaper now switches seamlessly between the two custom-made images. The bright indoor lighting emphasizes her enthusiastic reaction and the colorful screen.
